Game Overview

In Sprunki Santa Rescue, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an adventurous quest with Sprunki Santa, navigating a perilous lava-filled cave to save Christmas. Outsmart goblins through strategic pin-removal puzzles, ensuring safe gift recovery. Each level poses new challenges, demanding sharp thinking and timing to rescue Santa’s presents and restore holiday joy.
